title: Salah
summary: How Muslims pray, step by step.

picture.alt: A boy standing on a prayer mat by a window
A boy standing on a prayer mat by a window
A boy washing his hands under a tap

screens.text: I stand on a clean place and face the Kaaba.

picture.alt: The Kaaba in an old desert town

screens.text: I raise my hands and say: Allahu Akbar.
I stand still and recite the Quran quietly.

picture.alt: A boy standing still on a prayer mat

screens.text: I bow down with my hands on my knees. This is ruku.
I put my forehead on the floor. This is sujud.
I sit quietly between the sujud.

screens.question: What do I say when I start salah?

screens.text: At the end, I turn my head and say: Assalamu alaykum wa rahmatullah.

picture.alt: Two children sitting on a prayer mat

screens.text: You learned the steps of salah.

picture.alt: A boy standing on a prayer mat
